• 🦍 V3 handles chaotic battles well: A gorilla fights 10 men with convincing sound effects.

• 🤼 Two yarn sumos trash-talk each other, with V3 generating playful dialogue.
• 🐺 A first-person view of a wolf chasing a rabbit captures immense speed and dynamic movement.

Even though its impressive to see how far generative AI has come, its still really easy to tell it's fake as the footage doesn't align with the laws of the real world. Expressions are exaggerated, mouth movesments being the biggest indicator, but also speech as well, it doesn't align with how someone would normally speak. And the scenarios are very unrealistic too, it just all comes off as very forced. 

The thing with AI currently is it needs a lot of input in the prompt for it to generative convincing things, otherwise it tends to default to a certain pattern that is easy to pick up on after watching these videos enough, or viewing the art it creates enough times. I can see however how it could fool the average joe, right now AI is better used for things that follow a more basic ruleset, it can't compute real life correctly yet.
